subject: Data & Deployment Decisions — MAP standup (FinChain evaluation)
messages:
From: Julia Ramos <juliar@finchain.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Novak <alex.novak@finchain.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v2 + quick clarifications on data residency and retention

Hi Sean + Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Alex and I pulled together an updated mutual action plan (attached) with a tighter close timeline. Two quick clarifications before we lock dates:

1) We expect PII in a subset of payloads during evaluation (synthetic + redacted production samples). Is Redwood comfortable supporting evaluation in a customer-dedicated VPC with strict egress controls?
2) Retention: Procurement will ask for a documented retention/erase plan for KV/prefix caches and audit log retention during the eval period (30 days).

I've attached FinChain_MAP_v2.xlsx and the SOC2 question set. Can we confirm owners for the technical checklist by next Tuesday?

Thanks,
Julia Ramos
Senior Product Manager, FinChain
juliar@finchain.com
[Attachment: FinChain_MAP_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ramos <juliar@finchain.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 + quick clarifications on data residency and retention

Hi Julia — appreciate the clear asks and the updated MAP. High level: yes, we can run your evaluation inside a dedicated VPC (private deployment) with strict egress controls and customer-managed KMS. We'll outline exact constraints/owners below.

Summary of what we'll provide for the eval:
- Private VPC deployment (customer-managed routing and firewall rules)
- Option for on-prem/air-gapped deployment if needed for restricted samples (requires timeline add of ~2-3 weeks)
- KV/prefix cache TTL configurable; we can set to 0 for the eval to avoid persistent caches if you prefer
- Audit logs: default 90-day retention; we can provide a 30-day export snapshot to you and a retained internal copy for incident investigation (can be reduced with a written agreement)

Action items (initial):
- Karthik: provide network diagram and the minimal inbound/outbound ports for FinChain infra — due Thu 03/04
- Marissa: compile the procurement redlines on retention and provide to Sean for legal — due Mon 03/08
- Sean: schedule a technical call with FinChain infra and our deployment engineers — target Tue 03/09

If the on-prem option is required for any sample set, flag it now so we can update the MAP timelines.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
[Attachment referenced: SOC2_Questions_v1.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Ramos <juliar@finchain.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 + quick clarifications on data residency and retention

Sean / Marissa / Julia —

Attached is a concise network & deployment note (see redwood_network_diagram.png). Key technical constraints and options:

- VPC deployment: supports private subnets for inference and a bastion for management. Required egress rules:
  * Outbound to our telemetry endpoint (optional, can be disabled)
  * Outbound to model artifact registry endpoints (immutable during eval)
- Ports: 443 outbound primarily; management over SSH via bastion is possible with jumpbox rules
- On-prem: supported but requires a configuration window (2 weeks) and local infra validation (HW drivers, CUDA/cuda-runtime versions)
- Data handling: we can configure KV cache to be ephemeral (in-memory only) for eval; persistent logs can be truncated to 30 days and provided as an export.

Risks to call out:
- If FinChain must certify zero-exfil (no telemetry at all), we need a signed SLA exception and an explicit acceptance of limited observability for the duration of evaluation. This will impact our ability to debug performance issues remotely.

I'll join the tech call on 03/09.

--Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_network_diagram.png (image/png)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ramos <juliar@finchain.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 + quick clarifications on data residency and retention

Julia / team —

From a compliance perspective, a few specifics to confirm for the MAP and procurement: 

1) Retention & erasure: Redwood will document the erase process for prefixes, KV caches, and model input logs. For the 30-day eval period we can:
   - Provide an automated erase job that runs on demand and produces an audit receipt
   - Limit internal retention by scoping access to the incident response team only
2) PII handling: recommend that FinChain mark any truly sensitive fields. We'll accept redacted samples for model tuning. If unredacted PII is required in eval, we advise the private VPC + HSM-backed KMS path and a short on-prem pilot where needed.
3) Evidence pack: we'll produce a short evidence bundle (config snippets, export of retention settings, and audit receipts) to attach to your SOC2 questionnaire.

Action: If Procurement needs a written policy for the 30-day evaluation, I can draft a one-page retention & erase policy by Fri 03/12.

-Lauren Bishop
Head of Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ramos <juliar@finchain.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 + quick clarifications on data residency and retention

Julia — thanks for the patience while we pulled this together. Quick standup summary and owners (as requested):

Status: MAP v2 received; technical kickoff completed on 03/09; deployment target for dedicated VPC test: week of 03/22.

Confirmed decisions:
- Evaluation mode: dedicated VPC deployment with customer-managed egress; telemetry optional and can be disabled (FinChain to confirm)
- Retention: audit/log exports scoped to 30 days for the evaluation; internal incident retention can be reduced with a signed exception
- On-prem: available as an alternate path but requires +2 weeks to schedule and validate drivers

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Alex Novak (FinChain): flag whether telemetry must be disabled entirely — due 2027-03-18
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood): finalize network ports and inbound rules doc and upload to HubSpot — due 2027-03-18
- Lauren Bishop (Redwood): deliver 1-page retention & erase policy for procurement — due 2027-03-12 (in progress)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood): consolidate procurement redlines and send to Sean for legal review — due 2027-03-18
- Sean Gallagher (Redwood): update MAP timeline and circulate revised spreadsheet — due 2027-03-17

Next touchpoint: weekly MAP checkpoint on 2027-03-22 to validate deployment readiness and sample set approval.

If any of these owners need the deadlines moved, reply-all with constraints.

Cheers,
Sean
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
